notes:
1.1.2: update popup and in-place Settings check

- When a new version is found (on start, on resume, or from Check for
  updates) a popup shows the version, what's new and Update now / Later;
  Windows shows Restart to update once the download is ready
- Check for updates refreshes the Updates section in place instead of
  reopening Settings at the top, and says when you're already up to date
